title: THE THREE U12 CONTROL STRAPS WERE 50 mm FROM THEIR PINS AND THEIR COPPER IS TWO OF BQ25185_SYS's FIVE EDGES; THE 90-DEGREE ROTATION MAKES BOTH SWITCH NODES STRAIGHT; AND THE WHOLE RE-FLOORPLAN IS 18 AGAINST 18 BECAUSE THE SYS RAIL REACHES U12 THROUGH A 25.850 mm POUR ARM THAT PINCHES TO 0.200 mm
verdict: NOT PROMOTED -- clause 4 (board_improved) cannot be satisfied at 18 against 18

finding_1_strap_placement_defect.statement: R41 (1M PG pull-up), R42 (0R PS/SYNC strap) and R43 (100k EN pull-down) are ALL THREE of U12's control-pin straps and all three sat in a leftover passive row at y = 120.335, about 50 mm from a switching converter at (66.600, 101.400). Their three nets carry 93 routed objects across the congested middle of the board.

finding_2_the_rotation.statement: The TPS63020's two switch nodes are pins 6/7 and 8/9 -- ADJACENT around the package's east corner -- while L1 sits due NORTH of U12, so Net-(L1-Pad2) ran 3.4 mm straight and Net-(L1-Pad1) had to wrap the whole part through the 1.205 mm antenna band. Rotating U12 by +90 degrees turns the two 7-pad ROWS into two 7-pad COLUMNS and puts BOTH switch nodes at the columns' north ends, facing L1.
finding_2_the_rotation.this_is_the_fix_the_dru_already_names: hardware/demo/kicad/aqroot-demo/aqroot-Beta-v2.kicad_dru section 13, D-610 block: "THE PRODUCTION FIX IS A PLACEMENT CHANGE AND IT IS NOT SMUGGLED IN HERE. L1 sits 0.41 mm off U12's courtyard and boxes the VOUT row into a 1.4 mm corridor ... It is a Full Beta v2 item."
side_effects: EN / PS_SYNC / PG land on U12's EAST face looking at the free 3.3 mm back-side ribbon
VIN / GND / FB / VOUT land on the WEST face
the 1.205 mm band under U12 grows to about 3.3 mm because U12 also moves 2.4 mm north
U12.4 and U12.5 land inside the EXISTING PAD_ESCAPE_U12_4 and PAD_ESCAPE_RUN_U12_4 rule areas and re-join the +3V3 rail on the surviving D-610 relief run with no rule-area change at all

finding_3_the_blocker.statement: The charger's system rail reaches the buck-boost's VIN pins through a POUR ARM, and that arm is 25.850 mm long and 0.200 mm wide at its narrowest. Every additional track laid anywhere in U12's ribbon or pocket cuts it, so each of the last four edges cost exactly one BQ25185_SYS edge to buy.

next: The re-floorplan is correct and should be taken, but only TOGETHER with a real BQ25185_SYS conductor from U12.11 to U12.1 / C24.1 replacing the 25.850 mm pour arm.

The instrument that is missing is an OFF-CENTRE ESCAPE in the ordinary maze: maze3d.offcentre_route exists and screen_offcentre_launch proves U12.11 opens at 0.400 mm with a 0.060 mm anchor offset, but only join_taps uses it and --tap only serves ORPHAN lands, so a connected-but-fragile land can never ask for it.

The alternative is a PAD_ESCAPE_U12_11 / PAD_ESCAPE_RUN_U12_11 width licence of the D-610 shape, authored in the .kicad_dru BEFORE the router runs, and an ampacity ruling for the converter's INPUT current the way D-610 ruled on its OUTPUT.

addendum_the_island_jumper_and_the_one_c.statement: The re-floorplan DOES reach 17 against 18 -- one better than the authority -- and the instrument is the island jumper, not the launcher. But V3V3_FB's shortest route and that jumper want the SAME corridor, and the board admits exactly one of them.

2_and_the_trunk_floor_clause_charges_thi.the_defect: 2.19 A is section 5's LOCAL EXCEPTION for the U21 accessory boost -- 'the SYS segment that feeds U21 must be sized from that peak, not from 1.0 A' -- and D-689's own block says in its own words that the figure 'IS NOT THIS SEGMENT'S'. Charged to the whole class it can never be met: SYS_MAIN's own 0.800 mm opt carries only 2.026 A, so --trunk-floor is unreachable for this class by construction.
2_and_the_trunk_floor_clause_charges_thi.consequence: --escape-floor descends the ESCAPE to 0.500 mm but the TRUNK stays at the 0.800 mm opt, and the residual join then refuses with 'no all-layer corridor at 0.800 mm'.

3_the_island_jumper_is_the_instrument_an.ledger: BQ25185_SYS 5 -> 3; board 18 -> 17; real DRC one pre-existing violation (MK1)
3_the_island_jumper_is_the_instrument_an.why_it_matters: this replaces D-696 §4's 25.850 mm / 0.200 mm pour arm with a REAL conductor, so the one-for-one trade that held the whole transaction at 18 is broken

V3V3_FB.why_the_direct_lane_refuses: U12.3's ONE escape is walled north by the 0.600 mm +3V3 relief-run feed (65.000,98.800)->(64.150,98.700) and south by U12.1's 0.300 mm SYS escape (64.600,100.400)->(64.100,99.700), with /BQ25185_STAT2's 0.6 mm barrel at (63.200,99.800) and D-689's own SYS barrel at (61.675,99.500) beyond them
things_measured_and_refused: evicting /BQ25185_STAT2 from a 4.2 x 2.9 mm window: STAT2 relays in 21.340 mm, FB still NO_PATH
deleting the GND stitch at (61.100,100.200): still NO_PATH
deleting U12.1's north-west SYS escape: FB CLOSES, at 27.394 mm -- and BQ25185_SYS goes 3 -> 5
re-joining the SYS islands afterwards at 0.500 mm with a 40 mm bound: 0 joins, NO_PATH
moving R40 into the pocket at (62.500,101.500): the FB pair then relays at 29.188 mm and SYS regresses again
R39 has NO site in the pocket at all -- every candidate is inside 0.2 mm of a GND stitch barrel or the /ACC_5V_SW_EN track

4_and_the_last_edge_is_a_single_corridor.verdict: 17 with the buck-boost's FEEDBACK PIN OPEN is not shippable -- U12.3 floating is a dead 3.3 V rail, which is worse than any edge count -- and 18 with it closed is not an improvement. NEITHER CANDIDATE IS PROMOTED.

5_the_move_that_removes_the_competition_.idea: V3V3_FB hangs entirely off ONE barrel at (66.100, 99.250): 13 objects, an In2 haul to R40 and an In3 haul to R39 both terminating there. The U12 move swallows that barrel under U12.15 and THAT is what forced the whole chain out. Move U12 far enough north and the barrel survives, the FB net stays whole, and U12.3 needs only a 2 mm local link.
5_the_move_that_removes_the_competition_.recommendation: the 4.55 x 4.55 mm L1 is 0.045 mm too big for this stack-up of constraints. The clean fix is a SMALLER 1.5 uH inductor (3.0 x 3.0 mm class) with equal Isat and DCR -- a BOM change, priced and sourced, not a routing flag. With it, U12 sits at cy 97.0-97.3, the V3V3_FB barrel survives untouched, the FB net never opens, and the island jumper's 17 becomes the promoted number.
